title: Desk Note — Dashboard Users Beyond the Included Count on Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Dashboard Users Beyond the Included Count

Desk note on the part of an amended annual fee carried for named dashboard users beyond the count a tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions includes. The bulk user count is 5 users, the bulk user step is 10 percent, and a full first year is 12 months.

## Rule

Where the dashboard users on the subscription do not exceed the users the tier includes, no charge is carried for users beyond the included count. Where the users beyond the tier's included count are more than the bulk user count and the subscription's current term has run a full first year or more, every user beyond carries the tier's dashboard user fee less the bulk user step. In every other case every dashboard user beyond the tier's included count carries the tier's dashboard user fee.

## Condition table

| Users beyond the tier's included count | Whole months the current term has run | Charge carried for each user beyond |
|---|---|---|
| none | any | nothing |
| 1 to 5 | any | the tier's dashboard user fee |
| 6 or more | 12 or more | the tier's dashboard user fee less 10 percent |
| 6 or more | fewer than 12 | the tier's dashboard user fee |

The users counted are the named dashboard users standing on the subscription; the age of the term is counted in whole months from the term start date to the day of the amendment.

## Cases (hypothetical, tier including 20 users at USD 140 a user a year)

- 20 named users: nothing is carried.
- 25 named users, term run 30 months: 5 users beyond, which is not more than 5, so USD 140.00 each, that is USD 700.00.
- 27 named users, term run 30 months: 7 users beyond, more than 5, and the term has run a full first year, so USD 126.00 each, that is USD 882.00.
- 27 named users, term run 8 months: 7 users beyond but the term has not run a full first year, so USD 140.00 each, that is USD 980.00.
